eastFeed.rule: PRIMARY: eligible only on days with no Davenport (East) call assignment. BACKUP: allowed even on East call days (Faraz 9/21). East assignments are read from the Davenport app's schedule_weeks for the surgeon whose code is FAK.

s2.holidayPreference: Split Christmas: every other day, or 2 on then off

eastFeed.rule: Davenport week flagged isBackup (Fierce PRIMARY at East) → Fierce is Silvis BACKUP every day Mon–Sun. Davenport week flagged isFierceBackup (Fierce BACKUP at East) → Fierce is Silvis PRIMARY every day Mon–Sun (24/7).

timeOff.approval: none — surgeons enter their own vacations; the app logs them (audit) and blocks those days from call
timeOff.conflictRule: A vacation cannot be entered over a day the surgeon is already published as primary or backup — the entry is refused with the conflicting dates and a link to open a trade; enter the vacation after the trade is applied (the scheduler's only override is to edit the schedule first - the DB trigger refuses every caller)
timeOff.trailingEdge: A vacation day also blocks the day before it (the 07:00 shift end falls on the vacation day)

patterns.split: one surgeon Fri+Sun, another surgeon Sat

groupRules.dailyHandoff: Service hands off every morning at shift change; the weekend surgeon covers everyone Fri–Sun; only the primary must be physically in Silvis.
groupRules.holidayPolicy: Same holiday set as Davenport (3 major + 3 minor) as UNITS with one primary + one backup sticking through each unit — see holidays.rules.
groupRules.regressionScope: Hard-rule assertions in test/generator-regression.js apply to generator-placed slots only; locks are byte-identical (item 3) and lock collisions are reported as warnings; item 1 accepts externalCover; item 13 accepts 'uncovered with reasons'.

whitelistMonths.rule: A month is governed by an explicit date list only when it appears in surgeonRules[id].explicitListMonths (completed from the seed's explicitAvailable keys, for every surgeon who has one: Burchett Oct+Nov+Dec, Acton Oct (his November list is preferences since 9/22 evening, Prompt 12 Y), Philip Oct). In a governed month the eligible set for a governed ROLE is exactly the explicit available/backup_only rows minus unavailable rows; in other months (and for a role the entry does not govern) recurring patterns + weekendsAvailable minus unavailable rows. Dates in a list that spill into a neighbouring month are additive there and do not put that month into whitelist mode.
whitelistMonths.roleScope: 9/22 (Prompt 12 I + T): rules.js reads the role scope literally. A plain 'YYYY-MM' entry governs PRIMARY only (backup is open to everyone - Burchett's Oct, Acton's Oct); an object entry { month: 'YYYY-MM', roles: [...] } governs exactly the roles it names, so { month: '2026-11', roles: ['primary', 'backup'] } restricts BOTH roles (Burchett's November list: the ER-panel author published it, so he is not placed on a November day he did not offer in either role; Acton's November object entry left with Prompt 12 Y; 9/23: Burchett's December entry is the object form too - his 9/17 list names primary or backup). The importer keeps an explicit entry as written; when it completes a missing month from the explicitAvailable keys it writes the plain (primary-only) form for a plain or two-role list and { month, roles: [role] } for a one-role list - an author who wants backup governed writes the object entry in the seed. Under groupRules.backupPolicy.openToEveryone false a plain entry governs both roles again.

droppedFromDavenport: Fierce separate backup weeks (replaced by daily backup + derived weeks)
availabilityPrecedence: time_off (+ trailing edge: the day before a vacation blocks PRIMARY)
explicit available / backup_only rows (a dated row for a role lifts the next tier for that date and role only; a manual lock is not a row)

weekday-pattern rules a dated row lifts: hardNeverWeekdays (roles per hardNeverWeekdaysRoles, primary only by default since 9/22; row-liftable since 9/22 evening, Prompt 12 W), recurring patterns (recurringUnavailable), weekday patterns (weekdays.allowed, outsideDerivedWeeks incl. weekend-block-only), weeks / governed months, day-before-Aledo - since 9/22 every member of this tier restricts PRIMARY only unless its roles say otherwise (outsideDerivedWeeks is per-role data and says backup:true everywhere)

independent gates no row lifts: availableWindows (both roles, holidays included; edit the window in Setup instead - Prompt 12 W), backupOptOut (hard on every backup slot), East busy / forecast-busy, derived East weeks, caps, maxConsecutiveDays, same-day other role, holiday opt-outs
carriedOverFromDavenport: data management (backup, restore, export, import, snapshots)
all safety features (payloadLooksWiped, intentional-wipe ref, snapshot-before-destructive, restore UI, audit log)

rules.fairness: Track major and minor holiday counts per surgeon separately, lifetime, tenure-normalized (same idea as the Davenport holidayRate).
rules.unitModel: One primary + one backup per holiday unit; both stick through every day of the unit. A holiday unit takes precedence over the weekend unit it overlaps; the leftover weekend days form a reduced weekend unit.
rules.mondayMinor: A minor holiday (Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day) that falls on a Monday absorbs the weekend before it: the unit is Sat-Mon, one primary and one backup through all three days; the Friday stays a standalone weekend day (the reduced weekend unit). A minor holiday on any other weekday is its own day. July 4th is read on its observed day: a Sunday July 4 is observed Monday (Sat-Mon); a Saturday July 4 is observed Friday. Thanksgiving is Thu-Sun every year. Faraz 9/22 evening and 9/22 late; switch: groupRules.holidays.mondayMinorAbsorbsWeekend, applied when a year's units are built.
